answer_4.quote: In addition to automatic evaluation, we also conduct human evaluation to further study the performance of the proposed MCPredictor model. Specifically, we randomly select 100 samples in the development set. Without loss of generality, we select SAM-Net model to compare with MCPredictor manually under these samples.
answer_4.guideline: Humans compare the predictions of MCPredictor and SAM-Net to count the number of correct answers.
